description: This file defines shared React UI components for user experience, including Skeleton loading components, Empty State display, and a Filter Bar with mobile drawer support.

methods.name: SkeletonBlock
methods.description: A generic rectangular skeleton shimmer block component.

methods.name: SkeletonText
methods.description: A multi-line text skeleton component with configurable lines and line height.

methods.name: EmptyState
methods.description: A component displaying a friendly empty state message with optional actions.

methods.name: FilterBar
methods.description: A filter container component with inline and mobile drawer support.
